description: Returns a guest’s own view of an event, from the `id` and `token` join_event gave (both are in their link): `status` (asked: the host hasn’t answered yet; going; waiting; left; removed; declined: the host said no), `waitlistPlace` when waiting (1 is next), a `summary` in words, and the event, with the address or the link in `event.where` when they are going. Call it again to check whether someone waiting got a spot, or whether the host answered someone asking. Next: leave_event gives the spot up.

id.description: a guest id ("gst_…"): from get_event for a host, or the one join_event gave the guest
id.title: minLength(1)

token.description: the guest’s token: `token` from join_event, or the `token` in their link (".../e/<slug>?guest=<id>&token=<token>")
token.title: minLength(10)

name: get_event_guest
title: See a guest’s spot at an event
